items.title: Microsoft Teams: Show your shared content on both room displays
items.summary: Make presentations easier to see from anywhere in the room, even when you're not in a Teams meeting. On Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android with dual displays, content you share through an HDMI connection can now appear on both screens at once. You can start or stop showing your content on both screens

items.title: Microsoft Teams: External bot detection and activity reports in Admin Center
items.summary: Admins should be able to track the detection and meeting access activity of external bots in the meetings and events hosted in their tenant. GA date: January CY2027

items.title: Microsoft Viva - Viva Glint: Enhanced multi-attribute report exports
items.summary: Enhancements that are a part of this release expand who can use the Multi-attribute report export, increases the supported scale, and gives authorized users more control over the questions and attributes included. GA date: January CY2027

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Raise your hand to speak up at large events with up to 100,000 attendees
items.summary: Ask your questions live and take part in the conversation, even at events with up to 100,000 attendees. items.title: Microsoft Teams: Share reactions at events with up to 100,000 attendees
items.summary: Stay more engaged and connected with the audience, even at events with up to 100,000 attendees. Teams now supports reactions in events at this scale. You can send reactions during the event and see the reactions others send, so everyone can share the moment together. GA date: December CY2026

items.title: Outlook: Add Custom Flag Descriptions for Clearer Follow-Ups
items.summary: You can add custom text to an email's follow-up flag to describe what you need to do. Use your own words to capture the next step for each flagged message. This gives you a clear reminder of why you flagged the email when you return to it. #newoutlookforwindows GA date: February CY2027

cves.summary: Optimizely Web Experimentation before 2026-11-17 mishandles the account signup flow, leading to presence of attacker-controlled code in the projectJS (aka Project JavaScript) field of certain cdn.optimizely.com assets.
cves.kev_name: Optimizely Web Experimentation External Control of Critical State Data Vulnerability

cves.summary: Deserialization of untrusted data in double-submit cookie vs. form field validation in Idunno.AntiCsrf versions through 0.9.1 Beta on ASP.NET allows remote unauthenticated attackers to execute code via object injection
cves.kev_name: Idunno AntiCsrf Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability

cves.summary: monailabel (aka MONAI Label) before 0.8.6 allows directory traversal, with resultant remote code execution, via the image parameter to the PUT /datastore/image endpoint, as exploited in the wild starting in September 2026.
cves.kev_name: Project MONAI MONAI Label Path Traversal Vulnerability

cves.summary: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) before 20261121.1943 does not restrict the destination of the LDAP synchronisation connection check performed when a relay is configured. An authenticated API user can cause the server to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.
cves.kev_name: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability

cves.summary: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal allows an unauthenticated attacker to inject JNDI environment properties or pass a URL used during JNDI lookup operations, enabling access to an unintended JNDI provider.�This could further lead to disclosure or modification of information about the server. There is no impact on availability.
cves.kev_name: SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability

cves.summary: A vulnerability in the database service feature of Cisco Expressway Series could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker with network access to a Cisco Expressway device to execute arbitrary operating system commands as root. This vulnerability is due to the use of persistent cookies. Additionally, there is insufficient validation of client certificates when the TLS Verify Mode is set to Enabled
cves.kev_name: Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability

cves.summary: Deserialization of Untrusted Data in Apache Roller versions 4.0.0 through 6.1.4 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code. The XML-RPC endpoint accepts vendor extension types and deserializes them before authenticating the requester. This is the same vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384, which listed only Apache Roller 6.1.5 as affected. This issue is being actively exploited.
cves.kev_name: Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability

cves.summary: VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service. Affected versions: 9.1.x (fixed in 9.1.1.0200); 9.0.x (fixed in 9.0.2.0200); 8.0 (fixed in 8.0 U3m); 5.x (fixed in 5.2.5). Telco Cloud Platform 3.0, 4.x, 5.0.x, 5.1.x, 5.2 and Telco Cloud Infrastructure 3.0 are also affected (see KB463116).
cves.kev_name: VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability

cves.summary: build-git-clone before 1.0.4 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the clone() function that allows attackers to execute commands by supplying crafted repository URLs. Attackers can embed shell metacharacters such as ; or $() in the url argument, which is concatenated into a sh -c command, to execute operating system commands with Node.js process privileges.

Cron-parser through 5.10.0 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability in CronExpressionParser.parse() that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory by supplying oversized cron fields. Attackers can submit a roughly 1.6 MB expression of repeated wildcard tokens that expand into huge arrays, exhausting the V8 heap and crashing the Node.js process.

Dell Virtual Storage Integrator for VMware vSphere Web Client, versions prior to 10.12.0.0, contains an OS Command Injection – confirm single CWE vulnerability in Upgrade Service. A low privileged remote attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution.

Dell Virtual Storage Integrator for VMware vSphere Web Client, versions prior to 10.12.0.0, contains a Use of Hard-coded Credentials vulnerability in ssl_config.properties. An unauthenticated local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to credential exposure.

Dell Virtual Storage Integrator for VMware vSphere Web Client, versions prior to 10.12.0.0, contains a Server-Side Request Forgery SSRF vulnerability in httpRest.js. A low privileged remote attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to unauthorized access to internal services
